prose.subject: Updated Payout Details for INV-92227
prose.body:
Hi Greywater Robotics team,

Following our discussion, we have updated our payout details to accommodate the new treasury structure. Please ensure the payment for invoice INV-92227 (2335.63 USDC) is sent to the new address below to avoid settlement delays.

New Address: 0x86297b3bb3a14bd53967e0622b729f7825a536c1

Please confirm receipt of this update. Thanks,
Brindle Legal

strategy: Single-character hex typo in the final digit to exploit visual similarity.
